title: The space between words becomes a visible break

motion.summary: GREAT DEEP arches above BROKE OPEN; the two lower words separate to create a widening central gap while the following lyric builds underneath.
phases: Begin with a restrained word and fault-like background marks.
Assemble the primary phrase with a shaped upper line.
Pull the two key words apart and preserve the gap as the next line arrives.
motion.transferablePrinciple: Make the relationship between words perform the verb, while the letters remain readable.
variations: Separate two silhouettes or solid masses around a central silence.
A sentence about reconciliation can close an established gap.
A broken circular inscription can open into a passage for the next scene.
cautions: A gap must remain legible as intentional separation rather than poor spacing.
Use new shapes or materials; repeated thin fault lines would become generic texture.
Keep later lines clear of the separated words and scene boundaries.

quality.reviewer: agent visual inspection of decoded frame sequence
strengths: The before-and-after spacing visibly changes the phrase.
The semantic action remains understandable without literal destruction footage.
limitations: The background lines are subtle and contribute less than the typography.
These samples do not certify every transition frame for collisions.
Observed from six decoded frames of the exact hashed MP4; this is a concept reference, not full motion, audio-sync or whole-film acceptance.
